text:
Olivia: Hi team, my corporate card was declined at an EV charger during my trip to Berlin this morning. I have a photo of the point-of-sale screen and the decline message. Anyone able to confirm coverage?
Mike: bummer — do you have the decline code or merchant name?
Olivia: Decline code `05` and merchant shows as "E-Mobility-DE" on the terminal. Charge was €18.50. Attached photo: https://img.redwood.internal/olivia/ev-decline.jpg
Jamal: Those EV charger vendors sometimes MCC as utilities or unknown which trips the card provider flags. Did you try the backup personal card?
Olivia: I used a personal card to finish charging. Can I expense the €18.50?
FinanceBot: Reminder: expenses require an itemized receipt and manager approval for card declines. See policy: https://wiki.redwood/expenses#card-declines
Lisa: @Olivia, please upload the terminal photo + boarding pass + a short note on why card wasn't used (lost coverage) into Expensify and tag me. Once I have those I'll approve.
Olivia: Uploaded: Expensify TXN `EXP-314159`. Note includes personal card last4 `4242` and reason: corporate card rejected at POS.
Andrew: @Lisa quick Q — for small autorenew charging fees under €20, do we need manager pre-approval or can we fast-track?
Lisa: For this amount we can approve retro if there's the terminal image + manager ack. @Mike can you confirm Olivia's trip was approved?
Mike: Yep, this was an approved trip to Berlin (PRJ-238). I confirm she was on company business. 
Jamal: Adding that some chargers provide only the network transaction ID. If Expensify receipt is missing merchant VAT, finance may need the POS screenshot and transaction journal from the employee.
Olivia: I also have a PDF of the payment confirmation from the charger app: https://files.redwood/olivia/evreceipt.pdf
FinanceBot: Auto-check passed: amount matches, trip dates align, manager match = true.
Lisa: Approved. I'll mark `EXP-314159` as exception-approved and code to `travel:ground` with GL 6410. Olivia, we still need you to add a short note in the expense: "Corporate card declined at EV charger terminal; paid on personal card."
Olivia: Done. Thanks! :relieved:
Andrew: For follow-up, can we whitelist E-Mobility-DE in the corpcard MCC exceptions? This is the second decline this quarter.
Lisa: Filing a vendor exception with card provider now — request ref `CARDREQ-872`. ETA 3-5 business days.
Mike: Also can we bump the daily swipe limit for the travel pool to reduce these declines? Small Q but recurring.
Lisa: I'll sync with procurement and ops to check if limit increase is safe. If proc confirms, we'll request from provider.
Jamal: Noted for infra: sometimes these terminals send only contactless token which our provider flags. Whitelist might need both MCC and vendor BIN.
FinanceBot: Ticket CARDREQ-872 created by Lisa at 2024-05-06T09:15Z.
Olivia: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Saved the screenshot and receipts in case provider asks.
Lisa: Closing loop: expense approved and paid. If provider reverses decline and corpcard charge shows up, we'll reverse the reimb. For now all good. :thumbsup:
